legacy_pin_policy: Historical evidence stays with its original accepted graph and UNKNOWN missing pins; never infer from version or relabel it current. Current CLI rejects old format and completion markers.

transitive_lock.repository_file: package-lock.json in the exact CLI repository candidate
transitive_lock.install: Source npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --omit=optional requires all exact required registry archives in a verified npm cache; vendor files alone do not seed that cache. Unpublished local candidates use explicit local file archives and overrides for the complete required locked closure in a separate fresh-cache offline consumer. Embedding must independently enforce any required network denial.

publication_scope: Exact local archive binding; registry availability, release publication and named Host activation require separate evidence.
